ars_ocultas.page1.gem: Alternate recipe when diamonds are scarce.
ars_ocultas.page1.spirit_jar: Occultism Spirits can work inside Containment Jars. They maintain their original behaviour and do not decay making them perfect from automations! Spirit Jar will automatically pickup any item in 7x7 centered around it that matches spirit's filter (for crushing spirits, it will automatically pickup any ore that it can process).
ars_ocultas.page1.transmutation: You can convert surplus amounts of silver into gold and vice-vera!
ars_ocultas.page2.spirit_jar: Items can also be pushed into the containment jar using a hopper or starbuncles (any pipe should also work!). Players can also right-click any item directly on the jar. Spirits in Jars exhibit their default behaviour, this means that a Crusher Spirit will automatically process and fling the output in one of directions
ars_ocultas.page3.spirit_jar: Janitor Spirits inside jars have a special property. They automatically try to pickup items nearby and push to inventory next to it. This makes automation super easy!
